name: mathgames
description: Корневой package.json: удобный запуск всех микросервисов одной командой

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/auth install && npm --prefix services/gateway install && npm --prefix services/queue install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.db:auth: npm --prefix services/auth run db:generate && npm --prefix services/auth run db:push
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,gateway,core -c green,blue,yellow "npm --prefix services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix services/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
